NAM.note: Document is about payment service provider licensing; nothing on e-procurement.

facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia issued the PSD-1 determination under section 45 of the Payment System Management Act 2023, setting the licensing and authorisation of payment service providers, including electronic money issuers, effective on Gazette publication on 6 January 2026.
The Bank of Namibia's PSD-1 determination, effective 6 January 2026, carries user protection requirements for payment service providers (paragraphs 10.4 and 16 in its arrangement of paragraphs).

NAM.note: Nothing on cross-border payments in the captured text.
